stem:
A polygon is graphed on a coordinate grid with (x, y) representing the location of a certain point on the polygon. The polygon is transformed using the rule (x, y) → (ax, ay).

Which statement must be true?

options.label: F
options.text: If a is greater than 1, the image of the polygon is congruent to the polygon.

options.label: G
options.text: If a is between 0 and 1, the image of the polygon is congruent to the polygon.

options.label: H
options.text: If a is greater than 1, the image of the polygon is smaller than the polygon.

options.label: J
options.text: If a is between 0 and 1, the image of the polygon is smaller than the polygon.
